overview.text: Today's key developments highlight significant advancements in AI agents, reasoning models, video generation, and foundational releases. First, tool-use and agent reliability take center stage with Trajectory2Gym analyzing decision-grounded compositional interaction synthesis, and Trial by Trace benchmarking agent harnesses. Second, developers gain practical educational resources through a comprehensive video course on building reasoning models from the ground up using Python and PyTorch. Third, video generation moves forward with WorldCast enabling world-consistent character video generation with large-angle camera control, and World-in-Context advancing interactive video world modeling. Finally, the open-weights and model ecosystem expands notably with KRAFTON releasing Raon-1-mini-preview, a 30B-A4B Mixture-of-Experts language model trained from scratch, alongside major drops like Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B and Lightricks/LTX-2.5, providing researchers and engineers with powerful new assets for local deployment, multimodal tasks, and advanced video workflows.

entries.title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
entries.summary: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time.
entries.why: Critiques naive tool-use supervision by showing successful trajectories often underrepresent multi-step dependencies.

entries.title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
entries.summary: LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation.
entries.why: Provides a vital benchmark for evaluating AI agent harnesses regarding reliability and failure attribution.

entries.title: Building Reasoning Models from the Ground Up: A Full Video Course
entries.summary: Over 11 hours of coding videos on evaluation, inference-time scaling, reinforcement learning, and distillation, with Python and PyTorch.
entries.why: Offers extensive practical coding guidance on inference-time scaling, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

entries.title: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
entries.summary: Precise camera control is essential for cinematic character video generation, yet existing methods struggle to follow large-angle trajectories with combined rotation, translation, and radius variation from arbitrary initial azimuths.
entries.why: Solves complex camera trajectory challenges for cinematic character video generation with large-angle control.

entries.title: Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL
entries.summary: Rubric-based rewards enable effective reinforcement learning on non-verifiable tasks. However, because these rewards are typically defined as a weighted measure of rubric coverage, models are trained primarily to maximize a recall objective.
entries.why: Addresses the recall bias in rubric-based reinforcement learning by introducing a precision objective.

entries.title: World-in-Context: Interactive Video World Modeling with In-Context Conditioning
entries.summary: Interactive video world models require coordinated control over viewing perspectives, character actions, and camera motion.
entries.why: Enables coordinated control over viewing perspectives and camera motion in interactive video world models.

entries.title: Qwen-Image-PE: Learning Visual Design for Text-to-Image Prompt Enhancement
entries.summary: Learning visual design is essential for prompt enhancement (PE) to turn underspecified user requests into coherent visual specifications for text-to-image (T2I) generation.
entries.why: Enhances text-to-image prompt generation by teaching models visual design for coherent specifications.

entries.title: KRAFTON/Raon-1-mini-preview · Hugging Face
entries.summary: Raon-1 mini is a 30B-A4B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model, designed and trained from scratch by KRAFTON AI. It demonstrates strong capabilities in Korean conversation and agentic tasks.
entries.why: Introduces a novel 30B-A4B Mixture-of-Experts model trained from scratch with strong Korean and agentic capabilities.

entries.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
entries.why: Delivers a heavily downloaded image-text-to-text model from the Qwen ecosystem for multimodal pipelines.

entries.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
entries.why: Provides developers with an established open single-file diffusion model for image-to-video generation tasks.

entries.title: Greptile takes bug detection beyond code review with GPT-6 Astra
entries.summary: How Greptile uses GPT-6 Astra to test user workflows, Daybreak to strengthen security, and Codex to reduce rework.
entries.why: Demonstrates advanced enterprise bug detection and workflow testing using cutting-edge OpenAI models.

entries.title: How Fanatics and OpenAI streamline the fan experience
entries.summary: Fanatics uses OpenAI to help fans complete their game-day outfits with Shop the Look. Testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products showed 10% higher engagement.
entries.why: Showcases quantifiable user engagement improvements in retail environments through integrated OpenAI features.

entries.title: We tried to automate Epoch
entries.summary: Top models complete about two-thirds of our rubric on real work tasks.
entries.why: Provides empirical baseline data on how top models perform against rigorous real-world work rubrics.

entries.title: GPT-6.1 Terra
entries.summary: GPT-6.1 Terra It's always interesting to note which aspects of a new model are emphasized in the release announcement.
entries.why: Offers expert commentary on the strategic positioning and feature emphases of newly released frontier models.

entries.title: Amazon’s Trainium Takes a Strike at the Training King
entries.summary: Trainium Best for Inference? But now good for Training too, Native Trainium PyTorch, High Quality CI, TorchTitan, GPU Impossible Profiler
entries.why: Analyzes hardware shifts in model training architectures and the evolving competitive landscape for accelerators.
